items.title: Revolut hackers demand $3 million in Monero, threaten to sell customer data
items.summary: The group gave Revolut 24 hours to pay and said it targeted customers with significant crypto holdings.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Had Their Worst Day Since June Following Failed Clarity Act Vote
items.summary: Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP ETFs shed roughly $593 million combined Tuesday, their heaviest single-day drawdown since June.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $450 million as Clarity Act fails
Ethiopia cuts Bitcoin miners’ power by 77% amid hydropower shortage: Report
items.summary: Bitcoin miners generated 35% of the state-owned power producer’s revenue last year, but declining reservoir inflows led the utility to prioritize households and manufacturers.
